title: Romantic Getaway to Thailand with FREE Tickets to Big Buddha
highlights: Enjoy a romantic getaway to Thailand and explore some of the famous landmarks in its iconic cities, like Phuket, Krabi, and Koh Samui.
Make more memories with your partner and capture beautiful pictures as you admire the beauty of Phuket's skyline from Karon Viewpoint.
Visit Wat Chalong, the largest and most important Buddhist temple in Phuket and spend some time in peace as you admire its grandeur.
Seek blessings for your relationship and spend time in peace as you visit the beautiful Phuket Big Buddha, known to be a symbol of spirituality.
Explore Chicken Island in Krabi, where crystal-clear waters and a unique chicken-shaped rock formation create the perfect place for snorkelling lovers.
overview:
About the Tour:
From the picturesque white sand beaches like Railay to the ancient relics, Thailand is indeed the perfect destination for a romantic getaway. The sweet taste of much-famed nightlife, the delicious cuisine of famous streets and the thrill of unique water sports makes this place a must-visit destination. Whether you spend your time witnessing the architectural brilliance of Wat Phai Leam or the Big Buddha, stroll around barefoot on the stretches of white sandy beaches fringed with casuarinas and palms, getting a sweet taste of Phuket after sundown at Soi Bangla or an adventurous excursion to 4 Island from Krabi, this tour has everything for a perfect romantic getaway in the tropical paradise.


Quick info:
Destinations Covered: Phuket, Krabi, Koh Samui
Duration: 8 Days, 7 Nights
Start Point: Phuket International Airport
End Point: Phuket International Airport
inclusions: Transfer from Phuket International Airport to Deluxe Hotel
2 nights stay in Phuket with breakfast
Phuket City Tour - Phuket city tour with Big Buddha on a Shared basis
2 nights stay in Krabi with breakfast
Four Island Tour from Krabi - 4 Island with Lunch Box by Speedboat on a Shared basis
2 nights stay in Koh Samui with breakfast
Transfer from Deluxe Hotel to Phuket International Airport
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: You should carry your passport and visa at the time of arrival.
With the tropical climate, staying hydrated is essential. Drink bottled water and avoid tap water to prevent waterborne illnesses.

The currency used in Thailand is the Thai Baht (THB) so familiarize yourself with the current exchange rate and ensure you have enough cash or access to ATMs, especially if you plan to visit rural areas.
Adhere to designated smoking areas and respect non-smoking areas, which may include indoor spaces and certain outdoor areas.
Any personal expenses or items of a personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Phuket
days.desc: Welcome to the Pearl of Andaman! When you arrive at Phuket Airport, get transferred to your hotel. Once you check-in, the remaining day is yours to enjoy at leisure. You can explore Patong Beach, which is famous for its exotic cafes and nightclubs. You can also stroll along Bangla Road, a lively street known for its bustling nightlife, shopping, and entertainment. Once you have had fun, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Phuket Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, enjoy a sightseeing tour of Phuket. Take the pre-booked transfer from the hotel to the first stop, Karon View Point, famous for views of beaches like Kata Yai and Kata Noi. Next, engage yourself in the beauty of Wat Chalong Temple, known for its architecture. Continue the tour and visit the Big Buddha, a symbol of peace for the city. Lastly, stroll through Phuket Old Town to try Thai snacks and shop for souvenirs. Afterward, you'll get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Phuket City Tour - Phuket city tour with Big Buddha on a Shared basis

days.title: Transfer to Krabi
days.desc: After you check-out from the hotel, get transferred to Krabi, the Land of Cliffs and Limestone Beaches. Upon your arrival, check-in to your hotel and relax. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, indulging in activities that suit your interests. For a memorable experience, you can visit the Krabi Elephant Sanctuary and interact with these animals or explore the Krabi Weekend Night Market and see the local life of the place. As the day ends, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Krabi 4 Island Tour
days.desc: Wake up and get ready for an exciting Krabi 4-island tour. Begin with a transfer to Railay Beach to board a speed boat to Koh Poda Island, known for its stunning beauty. Next, enjoy the chicken-shaped rock formation of Chicken Island, then, relax on Tup Island's sandy paradise and finally, discover the beauty of Phra Nang Cave Beach. You can engage in some water sports like snorkelling, jet skiing, scuba diving and more. Later, transfer back to your hotel in Krabi for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer from Krabi to Koh Samui
days.desc: It's time to move from Krabi to Koh Samui, the Coconut Island. After you check-out, get transferred to Nathon Pier for your ferry to Koh Samui. Upon arrival, take the pre-booked transfer to the hotel and check-in. After you relax for a while, explore the city on your own and visit the stunning Big Buddha Temple, known for its various forms of Buddha. Also, you can see the Fisherman's Market and Secret Buddha Garden, among other spots. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Toyota Commuter
items.desc: 1 X Toyota Commuter will be Provided

days.title: Leisure Day in Koh Samui
days.desc: Today, you can relax and enjoy your day at your leisure. You can use it to explore the famous attractions on the island on your own. Visit Chaweng Beach, explore the sacred Wat Khunaram and see the Hin Ta & Hin Yai Rocks. If time allows, you can also go for an adventurous experience at Mu Ko Ang Thong National Marine Park, diving in the mesmerizing underwater world. After enjoying your time, return to the hotel at your own pace for an overnight stay.

items.title: Mu Ko Ang Thong National Marine Park
items.label: Suggestion

days.title: Transfer to Phuket
days.desc: In the morning, check-out and get transferred to Nathon Pier and take the ferry to Phuket. Sail across the calm waters of the Andaman Sea and take-in views of the islands along the way. Upon your arrival, get transferred to the hotel and check-in. For the rest of the day, you can relax or explore the city at your own pace by exploring some of its famous spots, like the Tha Rua Shrine, FantaSea, Freedom Beach, among others. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Toyota Commuter

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: As your unforgettable time in Phuket comes to an end, it's time to pack your bags and check-out from the hotel. You'll be transferred to the airport for your flight back home. This is where your trip ends. Have a safe journey!
